2610.11634.title: LTBD: Learnable Trust-Boundary Delimiters for Prompt Injection Defense
2610.11634.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) perform remarkably well on complex tasks, yet remain highly vulnerable to prompt injection attacks, where malicious instructions embedded in external data can override user intent. Existing defenses remain limited by model fine-tuning requirements, vulnerability to adaptive attacks, or reliance on brittle handcrafted prompts. We argue that a fundamental source of this vulnerability is the lack of an explicit representation of trust provenance. To address this, we introduce Learnable Trust-Boundary Delimiters (LTBD), a lightweight defense that explicitly encodes trust boundaries in the input while keeping the LLM parameters unchanged. LTBD uses a small number of learnable delimiters to distinguish trusted user instructions from untrusted external data, enabling the model to better respect the intended trust hierarchy. Experimental results show that LTBD substantially outperforms inference-time defenses and performs competitively with training-based approaches, while preserving benign-task utility and introducing negligible inference overhead. In particular, LTBD achieves 0.00% ASR on AlpacaFarm and only 0.11-0.19% ASR on TaskTracker. LTBD also remains effective under adaptive attacks, where adversaries have full knowledge of the defense and explicitly attempt to bypass it.
2610.11634.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在複雜任務上表現出色，但仍然對提示注入攻擊高度脆弱，這種攻擊中，嵌入外部數據中的惡意指令可以覆蓋用戶意圖。現有的防禦措施受到模型微調要求的限制，對自適應攻擊的脆弱性，或依賴脆弱的手工提示。我們認為，這種脆弱性的根本來源是缺乏明確的信任來源表示。為了解決這個問題，我們引入了可學習的信任邊界分隔符（LTBD），這是一種輕量級的防禦措施，明確地在輸入中編碼信任邊界，同時保持LLM參數不變。LTBD使用少量可學習的分隔符來區分受信用戶指令和不受信的外部數據，使模型能更好地尊重預期的信任層級。實驗結果顯示，LTBD的表現顯著優於推理時的防禦措施，並在與基於訓練的方法競爭時保持良好，並且引入的推理開銷微乎其微。特別是，LTBD在AlpacaFarm上達到0.00%的ASR，在TaskTracker上僅達到0.11-0.19%的ASR。LTBD在自適應攻擊下仍然有效，對手對防禦措施有充分的了解並明確試圖繞過它。
